title: Written semantic mention extraction output, v2
description: v2 carries only what the candidate pipeline consumes. evidence_fields, lookup_queries and relation_hypotheses are removed: nothing reads relation_hypotheses, evidence_fields is reconstructible from validated source references, and lookup_queries are generated deterministically after extraction. Token measurements for that removal are not stated here: they are properties of a particular model and tokenizer revision, and a schema describes what is legal rather than what one deployment cost. semantic/docs/OUTPUT_BUDGET_REPORT.md records what was measured and against which revision. Some scripts still overflow at maxLength 256 and need the tested overflow route rather than a schema change. Encoding note, 2026-08-19: the item and mention conditionals were re-expressed as anyOf variant objects and the string patterns were removed outright (xgrammar's matcher leaks on them; their guards moved to the Python layer), because xgrammar (vLLM 0.27.1's structured-output backend) cannot compile if/then inside allOf or lookaheads — measured on the RIS evaluation rig, where the model escaped the item envelope on every probe while the schema said additionalProperties: false. xgrammar also crashes on negated character classes containing non-ASCII members (bitset position 128), so the not-all-whitespace guard here covers ASCII whitespace only; strings that are entirely non-ASCII whitespace pass the schema and are refused by written_ontology.mention_extract_v2, the layer that exists for what JSON Schema cannot express. With that one named exception the accepted language is unchanged and tools/test evidence for that equivalence rides with the change.

items.description: Two, not four. The gateway accepts at most two indexed items and the contract calibrates for two; the schema is set to the same number so a third cannot be emitted by a model that misread its instructions. Raising it is a schema version change, which is correct: batch size is part of the output contract, not a runtime dial.

surface.description: Kept alongside the offsets during the first evaluation so the gateway can check surface == source[start:end]. One of the two may be dropped later if multilingual offset accuracy proves reliable; they must not both remain permanently without an accuracy reason. No pattern here on purpose: xgrammar 0.2.3's token matcher leaks on patterned strings (accepts token paths outside the string language, then admits schema-illegal continuations downstream — measured 2026-08-19 against the live endpoint and reproduced locally). The control-character and not-all-whitespace guards live in written_ontology.mention_extract_v2, the layer for what the schema cannot safely express.

start.description: Unicode code point offset, not a byte or UTF-16 offset. A surrogate-pair or combining-mark string makes the three disagree, and the gateway's equality check is what would fail.

family_hypothesis.description: music_recording is deliberately absent. 0221 removed recordings from the versioned ontology because identity is not vocabulary; a model emitting that family would reopen the minting route it closed.
